metadata.case_name: HO KAR CHEE v. TAM KWONG MAN AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: music teacher and tutor (part time basis)
plaintiff.education_level: Form 7; Higher Certificate in Valuation and Property Management (Hong Kong Polytechnic, 1994)

injuries.description: Inflammation of the soft tissues around the right knee that include the tendon of the gastrosnemius muscles, the tendons of the pes anserinus, the lateral collateral ligament, the medial collateral ligament, the tendon of the quadriceps muscle at its insertion onto the patella.
source: (a) Inflammation of the soft tissues around the right knee that include the tendon of the gastrosnemius muscles, the tendons of the pes anserinus, the lateral collateral ligament, the medial collateral ligament, the tendon of the quadriceps muscle at its insertion onto the patella.
She was diagnosed with right knee sprain injury.
injuries.icd_description: Injury to multiple structures of knee

manifestations.description: Severe right knee pain which is worse in bad weather.
Ambulation is impaired. Have to use umbrella as crutch and to disguise disability.
Difficulty in boarding buses because of knee problem.
Unable to tie shoe laces. Has to extend leg when doing so.
Can jog very slowly, swim slowly along the side of the pool.
Cannot play piano (press pedal), the violin (cannot stand for long), the accordion (cannot place this on knees).
Fear of travelling in taxis and other cars.
Impairment of sleep which is shallow totals three to four hours a night.
Nightmares of the accident once in half a month.
Flashbacks of the accident occurred daily.
Avoids conversation and thoughts of the accident; avoids socializing; cold to others; irritability; sense of foreshortened future in career; feels detached from others.

losses.description: Minor residual pain from right knee sprain injury.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: The Plaintiff has not been able to resume her activities such as swimming, jogging, playing basketball and badminton.
The Plaintiff’s enjoyment of work and enjoyment of life have been affected.

comparable_cases.case_name: Tam Wai Chun v Chor Sui Kwong
comparable_cases.injury_description: Knee injury with no fracture, few days hospitalization followed by physiotherapy and residual pain which caused plaintiff unable to take up some sports.

comparable_cases.case_name: Wong Wai Hong v Woo Kin & Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: Sprained right ankle without fracture or ligament damage; discharged same day; physiotherapy; difficulty squatting and other functions; assessed 1.5% permanent disability.
